scenes.vo: New Zealand were seventy for five. Then one batter refused to get out.
scenes.cap: New Zealand were 70/5. Then one batter refused to get out.

scenes.vo: First Test, Basin Reserve, Wellington. Shubman Gill won the toss and chose to bowl.
scenes.cap: 1st Test, Basin Reserve, Wellington. Gill won the toss, chose to bowl.

scenes.vo: Henry Nicholls finished on one seventy five not out, from three hundred thirty five balls.
The star means not out. All ten New Zealand wickets fell, and Nicholls was still standing at the other end.
scenes.cap: 175* = not out. All 10 wickets fell; Nicholls was still there.

scenes.vo: Glenn Phillips added one eighteen, and New Zealand reached three sixty eight.
scenes.cap: Glenn Phillips 118. New Zealand all out 368.

scenes.vo: For India, Bumrah took four for ninety two, and Akash Deep three for fifty three.
From seventy for five, to three sixty eight. Can India's batters answer? Comment below.
